hypotheses.old_body_visibility_defer: Deferred restore and live reparent hiding satisfy8functional cases but do not remove material-null errors. Thus fallback visibility alone is not sufficient explanation/fix.
hypotheses.specific_material_ownership: Eight native surfaces get duplicate per-instance override materials. Only4roles (jacket,skin,hands,pants) also have parent-surface material handles. The remaining4roles (hair,shoes,detail,eye) are owned only by MeshInstance override members. Each tested avatar destruction reports exactly4material dependency errors, even with a valid original fallback material. Godot releases derived-class material members before VisualInstance destructor frees its render instance RID. A parent-surface strong-reference array for every owned override is a minimal controlled fix candidate.
hypotheses.confidence: Strong source/quantity match;await root one-variable A/B before declaring fixed.

safe_fix_proposal: Surface owner retains all created duplicate materials in a per-instance Array[StandardMaterial3D] until its child mesh instances are destroyed;no static material cache,no global leak,no colour/PBR change,no mesh detach/reparent special case.
scope: Lifecycle diagnosis;not game-art acceptance. Startup certificate error is separately recorded and not ignored by the ERROR gate.
